scientific_integrity: All mathematical assertions are supported by the self-contained analytic derivation; computations are corroborating finite checks, not a proof of arbitrary k.
scientific_limitations: Exact linear stability only for uniform positive coupling in a cyclic smooth map; no critical nonlinear stability, global basin, or actual nonlinear bifurcation existence is claimed. Independent publication priority and proof audit remain open.
title: Parity-selective first instability in cyclic rational-delay dynamical maps
